justification: core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/detector/Detector.java:17-90 shows a small static utility with one public entry point and only a handful of direct dependencies (5 ZXing imports and 4 JDK imports). A repository-wide search of core/src/main/java and core/src/test/java found only one source caller, core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/PDF417Reader.java:32,87, which imports Detector and invokes Detector.detect(...). That is low fan-in and low fan-out, so Hub-like Modularization is not supported.
